travel_contract.destination_unlock: Enter that station's public concourse on foot. Set only its visited flag in a native map callback. Viewing the timetable or riding past a stop does not unlock it.
travel_contract.boarding: Conductor on the only public platform throat. Destination menu lists the four other stops in line order; unvisited stops are visibly unavailable and are checked again before any boarding movement.
travel_contract.fare: Free regional return travel. No mandatory new fee or rail-pass fetch quest.
travel_contract.story_gate: Q03 St. Paul courier event EVENT_MN_COURIER_DEFEATED activates passenger service. This is not Q06's Grand Rapids EVENT_MN_DEPOT_CLEARED.
travel_contract.no_progression_bypass: Both service-active and destination-visited checks precede animation and map load. No gym, route checkpoint, lighthouse, survey or Safari flag is granted by a ride.
travel_contract.presentation: Use the existing native special MagnetTrain with direction matching the stop indices, followed by an explicit destination map load and protected floor arrival. Keep movement, dialogue, menu cancellation, animation and warp continuation on VisibleShellController.
travel_contract.arrival: Disembark inside the destination public concourse, south of its blocked boarding throat. Arrival must not step on a departure warp or replay a departure scene.
travel_contract.cancel: B or Cancel closes the ticket surface without moving, charging, changing flags or leaving input owned by dialogue.
travel_contract.persistence: Visited stations and service activation survive Save/Continue; destination selection and an unfinished ticket menu are not progression flags. Test Continue after actual arrival.
travel_contract.city_integration: Each source station needs an exact native exterior door, passive floor return, reciprocal exit pair and public walk to the city's existing route ports before publication. A station is not proof that its unfinished city is playable.

publication_checks: Walk from a real route port to each station entrance; prove the same door returns to its own public approach.
Deny travel before the courier event, with zero visited destinations, and to each unvisited destination even if a stale menu selection is supplied.
Exercise at least one northbound and one southbound animated ride with actual authoritative map changes and disembarkation.
Verify all 20 directed source/destination bindings, Floor arrivals, no departure-trigger overlap and unique callback flags.
Cancel with B; movement and Start must recover. Refuse walking around the conductor into track/train doors.
Save/Continue after boarding; verify visited flags, route story flags, money and party data are retained.
Retain every whole-map render, native capture, preconversion original, crop and rejected revision.
